03 Agents, tool selection and bounded execution
MERMAID adaptation: a compact typed claim plan guides an Executor that alternates source retrieval and evidence-grounded judgment.
Use statement, plan and recalled passages.
Automatic search across all three filings.
Merge unique passage IDs into context.
Count retrieval as one logical tool call.
JSON argument schemas; chooses a call.
then search a gap or submit_verdict.
For submit_verdict: run the evidence gate.
observations / errors are appended; next model request sees the accumulated state
Default total across both agents: 8 model calls / 16 tool calls.
Final slot, or two searches with no new evidence: submit-only.
Valid candidate → complete. Exhaustion / model failure / repeated
unstructured output → incomplete with an explicit stop_reason.
The model selects named tools; Python executes them.
Malformed plan → fall back to original statement.
Bad arguments, missing passage or rejected quote → error feedback.
One format reminder; retries remain inside the same budgets.
Ollama client: qwen3.5:9b, temperature 0, think=False, 8,192-token context, up to 1,800 output tokens, 120-second request timeout. Calls and retries are counted.

Three kinds of reuse, with different purposes
Parsed-PDF cache: avoid extracting unchanged documents again.
Corpus index: fast search over canonical page passages.
Evidence memory: reuse authenticated sources across claims.
No answer cache. Memory reads/writes are measured separately

06 FastAPI, live events and reviewer experience
One service implementation powers HTTP streaming, ordinary JSON responses, the Streamlit reviewer, the CLI and the benchmark harness.
Enter one statement or upload TXT / JSON.
A batch is sequential client-side requests,
not a separate batch API endpoint.
Citations: filing, PDF page, exact quote
Full JSON, raw events, report downloads
Server-sent event protocol | one run_id per stream
On service error: error → done(outcome=error); cancellation propagates.
Client checks content type, event shape, matching run IDs, final result and done.
A truncated / mixed / failed stream is shown as an error, not a successful report.
Model/tool events include observable actions and measured usage, not private reasoning.
Default budgets: 8 model / 16 tool calls; allowed maxima: 20 / 40.
Invalid API input → HTTP 422. Batch: 1–100 statements.
Batch import extracts statement text; gold labels never go to the API.
An asyncio.Lock serializes runs inside one API process.
Separate CLI processes are independent; there is no global scheduler.
Client timeout: connect 5s / stream read 180s; Ollama request 120s.
Unknown token counts stay null; incomplete status remains explicit.
SSE = server-sent events over HTTP. Streamlit consumes the stream through ui_client.py; model inference stays local through Ollama.
Tool calls carry typed arguments. Source metadata is resolved by Python after citation authentication; the model does not invent provenance.

09 Local deployment, responsibilities and design boundaries
The application runs on one Mac. Python handles deterministic mechanics; the local LLM handles claim interpretation, tool choice and semantic judgment.
UI session state holds run results.
CLI / evaluation bypass the API layer.
No model call for search or arithmetic.
Shared client used by both agents
documents.py / ingestion.py: manifest, PDF parse, fingerprints, index
memory.py: validate / recall / persist source evidence
evaluate.py: 20 × 3 benchmark and accuracy / usage accounting
api_evaluate.py: additional native HTTP / SSE checks
main.py / cli.py / workflow.py: command-line entry points
tests/: contracts, faults, budgets, source checks and reviewer tests
MERMAID: Decomposer + Executor + Toolset + Memory retained.
Web retrieval → fixed official PDFs; MCP tools → Python registry.
Full graph decomposition → one compact typed claim plan.
Lexical BM25 / FTS5; no embeddings or semantic reranking.
No OCR, durable graph checkpoint, or independent compound splitting.
Page-neighbour reads help table continuity; not a full table engine.
Source quotations establish provenance; final meaning remains model-dependent.
Run API: python -m uvicorn filing_checker.api:app | UI: python -m streamlit run streamlit_app.py | Ollama must be running with qwen3.5:9b installed.
